description: This file defines types and functions related to managing cache control policies for the Anthropic API, including resolving cache control settings, applying them to system prompts and messages, and handling cache markers.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicEphemeralCacheControl
methods.description: Resolves cache control settings based on cache retention and base URL.

methods.name: applyAnthropicCacheControlToSystem
methods.description: Applies cache control to system prompt blocks, handling cache boundaries.

methods.name: stripAnthropicSystemPromptBoundary
methods.description: Removes cache boundary markers from system prompt text.

methods.name: applyAnthropicCacheControlToMessages
methods.description: Applies cache control to the last user message or content string.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicPayloadPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the payload policy including capabilities and cache control settings.

methods.name: applyAnthropicPayloadPolicyToParams
methods.description: Applies the payload policy to parameters, including service tier and cache control.

methods.name: applyAnthropicEphemeralCacheControlMarkers
methods.description: Adds ephemeral cache control markers to system and assistant messages.
